findings.title: Local-first architecture with strict AI boundaries
findings.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_V1.md specifies a modular monolith using React/Vite/TypeScript, Dexie/IndexedDB, Zustand, Web Workers, and no backend. AGENTS.md and README.md confirm AI (via packages/ai-adapter) is limited to image understanding, conversion parameter recommendation, and result review. No image generation, editing, or redraw is permitted. All bead-cell calculations, color matching, stock logic, and exports remain local and deterministic.

findings.title: Stock and progress integrity rules are transactional and revision-bound
findings.detail: AGENTS.md mandates IndexedDB transactions for stock changes that are idempotent and traceable; viewing or editing patterns must not implicitly deduct stock; reversals must generate reverse ledger entries. README confirms settlement reversal is whole-ledger, progress is bound to a revision, and a changed revision requires new settlement before further deductions.

findings.title: Versioned backup and schema contracts with checksum-gated restore
findings.detail: README and AGENTS.md specify ZIP V2 backups containing original images, recognition evidence, patterns, stock, ledgers, operations, progress, and public AI configuration. ZIP checksum verification is required before restore. API keys are excluded from backups. PatternDocument identity follows Schema V1 using brand/series/code, not HEX. Old V1 backups remain compatible.

findings.title: GitHub Actions disabled; local verification is the current gate
findings.detail: README and AGENTS.md state GitHub Actions are intentionally disabled until formal project completion. Validation relies on local scripts such as npm run check, npm run palettes:verify, npm run recognition:eval, and npm run test:e2e. The only observed event in this snapshot is PROJECT_REGISTERED; no CI, deployment, or push events are present.

findings.title: Licensing constraints restrict code and data reuse
findings.detail: The project is Apache-2.0. IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_V1.md flags GPL-3.0-only and AGPL-3.0 projects as unsuitable for source copying, and notes QiaoGrid lacks an overall open-source license. AGENTS.md prohibits copying GPL/AGPL/unlicensed source and requires THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md registration for legally reused data. MARD palette data must preserve source and version.
